content:
Maya Patel: Notes from today's onboarding + finance sync with two customers. Capturing feedback for product and CS processes.
Maya Patel: Pain point: finance teams see invoice totals that don't match route-level usage. They need a reconciliable export.
Daniel Kim: Can we surface route-level daily exports? That would let customers join on invoice IDs.
Rosa Alvarez: CS ask: add a step in onboarding checklist: 'confirm route-to-invoice mapping with customer's finance contact'. Simple wording.
Ethan Zhou: Product idea: add an optional CSV export in billing UI `route_id,date,tokens,cost_usd,invoice_line_item` and a nightly job to generate per-customer files.
Maya Patel: Renewal risk: both accounts mentioned they'd revisit renewal in ~8 weeks if accounting can't reconcile. Marking as medium risk.
Daniel Kim: I'll add billing export to RH-5012 and attach sample CSVs from customers.
cs-bot: Ticket created RH-5012: "Customer billing export & onboarding checklist" https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RH-5012
Rosa Alvarez: I'll draft the checklist text and an AM script to run during handoff. Also request: include a help doc explaining common reconciliation issues.
Ethan Zhou: For implementation, first pass daily export to S3 + link from billing UI. If needed later we can support hourly.
Maya Patel: OK action items: Daniel scopes RH-5012, Rosa drafts checklist + help doc, Ethan outlines S3 export. I'll follow up with customers next week and include the AM script. :thumbsup:
Daniel Kim: Adding customer attachments to the ticket now.
Rosa Alvarez: Will post checklist draft in RH-5012 by EOD.
